turns.text: Hi, yeah, it's Beth. Sorry, it's really loud here, I'm at the airport.
Hi Beth, I can help with that. Could I have your booking code and last name first?
Sorry, what? Oh, it's F, G, 7, J, 1, L. Carter.
Thank you. I have your Dubai to Paris booking on SK312 today at 19:15, in Economy. What would you like to change?
Sorry, what? Today? Um, yeah, I need to switch to tomorrow. Can you do that?
Yes, I can look at that. Your flight is today and the booking was made more than 24 hours ago, so a voluntary change costs a 75 dollar fee on Economy, plus any fare difference.
Sorry, what? Okay, sure, that's fine. Can you get me on the nine o'clock?
The nine o'clock to Paris tomorrow is SK310 at 09:00, Economy at 430 dollars. Today's nine o'clock has already left, so I'll move you to tomorrow's. Shall I confirm the change?
Sorry, what? Tomorrow, yeah. Yes, go ahead.
You are now on SK310 tomorrow at 09:00 in Economy, with the 75 dollar change fee and the fare difference applied. Is there anything else I can help with?
Sorry, what? No, that's it. Thanks, bye.
